messages:
Samir K: FYI - customer on Windows (corp laptop behind a corporate proxy) is hitting our Go SDK stream and seeing intermittent JSON decode errors. They report: `json: unexpected end of JSON input` while streaming; happens ~2000 tokens in and then SDK stops with io.ErrUnexpectedEOF.

Priya N: Thanks Samir. Which SDK version + go runtime? Any logs or minimal repro?

Samir K: SDK v0.18.3, Go 1.20. Customer attached logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T14:03:21Z ERROR stream: decode failed: json: unexpected end of JSON input
2026-03-15T14:03:21Z WARN stream: read error: EOF
2026-03-15T14:03:21Z INFO http: proxied via https://proxy.corp:8080
```
They also tried increasing timeouts and toggling retries but same.

Morgan L: Quick hypothesis: corp proxy is doing TLS MITM / chunk coalescing and Windows TLS stack + proxy combo can return partial reads that break our stream-scanner assumptions. We had one similar with an internal partner where HTTP chunk boundaries got merged and the scanner treated a fragment as final.

Samir K: I gave customer a tiny repro they can run locally, they reproduced consistently. Repro snippet they used: 
```go
client := &http.Client{
  Transport: &http.Transport{
    Proxy: http.ProxyFromEnvironment,
    // customer used default transport, behind corp proxy
  },
}
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream", bytes.NewReader(payload))
resp, err := client.Do(req)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
scanner := redwood.NewStreamScanner(resp.Body)
for scanner.Scan() {
  tok := scanner.Token()
  fmt.Println(string(tok))
}
if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil { log.Printf("scanner error: %v", err) }
```

Priya N: Good — can you grab full http-level logs (raw response chunks) or request customer run `curl --raw -v` against the same endpoint to show chunk boundaries? Also need Go runtime version (go env).

Samir K: Asked for curl output and pcap; customer says they can't run pcap but will try `curl --raw -v`. They sent additional log showing repeated small chunk sizes: `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` with many small chunks ~256-1024 bytes.

Morgan L: Two immediate mitigations to try on customer side:
- Set http.Transport.ForceAttemptHTTP2 = false (some proxies do odd HTTP/2 <-> HTTP/1.1 conversions).
- Set Transport.DisableCompression = true (avoid intermediate decompress/coalesce by proxy).
Also wrap resp.Body in a bufio.Reader and use a streaming JSON decoder that can tolerate partial tokens: `dec := json.NewDecoder(bufio.NewReader(resp.Body))` and call `dec.Token()`/`dec.Decode()` loop — that will handle tokens across Read boundaries better than naive scanner which expects full chunk-per-message.

Priya N: Could we add a short snippet for support to send to customers?

Morgan L: Yes, send both: (1) quick client toggle, (2) robust decoder example.

--- snippet 1 (transport tweaks) ---
```go
tr := &http.Transport{
  Proxy: http.ProxyFromEnvironment,
  ForceAttemptHTTP2: false,
  DisableCompression: true,
}
client := &http.Client{Transport: tr}
```

--- snippet 2 (bufio + json.Decoder) ---
```go
r := bufio.NewReader(resp.Body)
dec := json.NewDecoder(r)
for {
  var m map[string]interface{}
  if err := dec.Decode(&m); err != nil {
    if err == io.EOF { break }
    log.Printf("decode error: %v", err)
    break
  }
  // handle m
}
```

Samir K: Sent both snippets to customer. They tried ForceAttemptHTTP2=false + DisableCompression=true and said failure rate dropped dramatically. Still saw one failure in ~20 runs. They ran with Go 1.20; asked if Go runtime upgrade could help.

Morgan L: We should test Windows + corp-proxy matrix on CI. Actionable things:
- eng: add a Windows CI job that runs stream-scan repro behind an httptest proxy that simulates MITM/chunk coalescing. (Morgan -> assigned)
- eng: add a defensive change to stream scanner to accumulate fragments until valid JSON token or a larger buffer threshold before returning EOF error. (Morgan)
- support: ask customer for curl --raw output and, if allowed, a pcap. Suggest using the transport toggles as a workaround. (Priya)

Priya N: Noted. I've asked customer for curl output and to try Go 1.21 if possible. Also proposed short-term workaround: run process on Linux host or container (customer has one) which they said reduced failures to zero.

deploy-bot: Created internal issue RW-4934 linking to this thread: https://redwood.internal/issues/RW-4934 (eng: add Windows proxy test + scanner hardening).

Samir K: Customer happy with workaround for now. Will escalate if they want a patch release. Leaving thread open until eng confirms CI test and planned fix. :white_check_mark:
